description: Counts trigger pulses and passes them on until a set number has been reached, with start and stop triggers in and out

params.text: Sets how many pulses are passed before the counter stops, a whole number from 0 to 128
Starts the counter by hand and sets the count back to zero
Stops the counter by hand and clears the count

inputs.text: Scales the count set by the Length knob by its voltage over 10V, so 5V halves it
The pulses being counted; each one is passed on while the counter is running
A rising edge starts the counter and sets the count back to zero
A rising edge stops the counter and clears the count

outputs.text: Carries the input pulse at 10V while the counter is running, and nothing once it has stopped
A 1ms pulse at 10V when the counter starts
A 1ms pulse at 10V when the counter stops, whether from a stop trigger or from reaching the set length

notes: the two Start jacks are added together before the rising edge is detected, and so are the two Stop jacks, so a steady voltage on one shifts what the other does
the counter comes up stopped, so no pulses reach Trigger Out until a rising edge arrives at a Start input or the Start button is pressed

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
